title: Top-Ranked Product Change
scenario: Identify products that moved from #1 to outside the Top 3 in subsequent weeks.
tableSchema: ranking (prod_id INT, week INT, rnk INT)
hint: Use LAG() to check rank from previous week.
correctQuery: SELECT prod_id FROM (SELECT prod_id, week, rnk, LAG(rnk) OVER(PARTITION BY prod_id ORDER BY week) as prev_rnk FROM ranking) t WHERE prev_rnk = 1 AND rnk > 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE ranking (prod_id INT, week INT, rnk INT);
